Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Henan zheng lumian: a generous plate of fine wheat noodles steamed with pork belly slices and short green bean segments. The thin tangled noodles are matte golden-brown from absorbed savory soy-based cooking juices, pleasantly separated and fluffy, with browned pork belly and green beans interspersed. This is a dry steamed noodle dish, no soup, no broad ribbon huimian noodles, no thick Beijing gravy.
